findings.body: Initializing the last layer of the action MLP with zeros when adding action conditioning to a pretrained model prevents perturbation of the pretrained state and empirically improves physics modeling.

findings.body: Training data is organized as a pyramid structure with web data and human videos at the base, synthetic/simulation data in the middle, and real robot data at the top, enabling effective use of heterogeneous data sources

findings.body: A single unified model with one set of weights can generate manipulation behaviors across single-arm, bimanual, and humanoid embodiments through embodiment-specific encoders and decoders
